display_doctrine: Headline personnel accounting uses readable public categories. Dated snapshots remain dated; event history is not overwritten by later aggregates.

notes: 18 is the combined U.S. military death total, not 18 KIA.
Retain 1 MIA in the public personnel summary under the current project adjudication; historical event states remain independently date-scoped.
Do not sum KIA/WIA/MIA into a unique-person total without item-level deconfliction.
